scenarios.name: Inspect project information from the template chooser

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/ActiveProject.opj` as its first project and `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` as its part
`Sketch1` is visible and the new-document template chooser is open
a template is selected with its details displayed
the user chooses Projects in the chooser
a Projects dialog opens above the chooser
the dialog lists project names and locations
the dialog displays a project settings tree
New, Browse, Save, Apply and Done controls are displayed
the user chooses Done without changing the project
the template chooser is displayed again
the selected template details remain displayed
